name: EPUB export (a namespace as a book)
description: Exports a namespace as an EPUB e-book: the page named like the namespace (its title and text) is the front matter, each page directly in the namespace is a chapter, in the namespace's sort order. For notes, procedures and documents written in Markdown. It never handles patient data: reports (the reports namespace) and pages with a patient block are refused, or left out as chapters. No images are embedded.

language.label: Language
language.help: The book's language code (dc:language): ro, en, fr, en-GB
